SuccessPage.title: Thank you for validating your child’s birth registration data!
SuccessPage.success-confirmation-title: {name} now has a valid birth certificate!
SuccessPage.success-confirmation-text: The birth certificate is available digitally. If there is a need for a physical birth certificate you can get it following the next steps:
SuccessPage.instructions-title: How do I get a physical birth certificate?
SuccessPage.find-registry-office: Find your nearest Civil Registry Office
SuccessPage.benefits-title: Benefits of having a valid birth certificate
SuccessPage.school-enrollment: Easy School Enrollment: A birth certificate is important when signing up for school in Kenya. It helps prove your child's age and nationality, making the process smoother for starting primary or secondary education.
SuccessPage.service-access: Access to Services: It helps you access important government services, like healthcare or social programs. Plus, you'll need it to apply for things like a Kenyan ID card or a passport.
SuccessPage.legal-security: Legal Security: Having a birth certificate protects your rights. It proves who you are, making it easier to handle things like claiming inheritance, getting a job, or dealing with legal matters later in life.
SuccessPage.go-to-office-title: Go to your nearest Civil Registry office
SuccessPage.go-to-office-text: You can receive the birth certificate at any Civil Registry Office. The office does not need to be in the area where your child was born.
SuccessPage.show-id-title: Show parent’s ID and confirm your request
SuccessPage.show-id-text: Ask the accountant to issue the physical birth certificate for your child. Parent’s valid ID is necessary for this.
SuccessPage.wait-certificate-title: Wait for the certificate to be issued
SuccessPage.wait-certificate-text: Wait for the certificate to be issued
